In case you missed it, none other than SB19 sang this year's anthem for the 2025 "Honor of Kings" International Championship!

The world’s most played mobile MOBA (Multiplayer Online Battle Arena) unveiled music video on its official Facebook page.

"Performed by SB19, one of the most iconic voices from the Philippines, this track celebrates the passion and fire that drive every team to #RiseforHonor," it said.
